evidence: Full snapshot: 197,882 rows; downloaded 2026-10-12T07:59:09+00:00; latest inspection 2026-10-09.
possible_reason: Records can be published late or revised; 2026 is a partial year.
effect_and_action: Freeze the source version and hash; do not compare partial 2026 volume with full years.

evidence: 28,448/185,270 development rows are not Fail, Pass or Pass w/ Conditions.
possible_reason: Closure, readiness or entry issues can prevent a judgement.
effect_and_action: Exclude from supervised targets, retain strictly earlier visit history; never relabel as pass.

possible_reason: The current inspection process produces both the narrative and result.
effect_and_action: Exclude current Results, Violations and violations_missing from candidate inputs.

possible_reason: Incomplete recording is plausible; missingness need not be random.
effect_and_action: Use fixed UNKNOWN categories; fit numeric filling and missing indicators only on training rows.

evidence: 7 blank licences and 418 zero licences in development data.
effect_and_action: Keep identifiers as strings; do not group every zero/missing licence as one establishment.

evidence: 167 licence numbers have more than one normalized address.
possible_reason: Moves, spelling changes, reuse or recording errors are possible.
effect_and_action: Treat licence groups as provisional; compare with licence-plus-address grouping.

evidence: Full snapshot ID duplicates: 0; development repeated groups: 24,777; 96.33% of rows belong to repeated groups.
possible_reason: Inspections recur at the same premises.
effect_and_action: Keep repeated visits; use chronological evaluation and report known/unseen establishment results.

evidence: 1,292 establishment-date groups have multiple visits; 57 have both labels.
possible_reason: Several visits, reporting conventions or conflicting records may explain this.
effect_and_action: Aggregate dates before shifting; retain mixed earlier dates explicitly and do not order by ID.

evidence: Facility Type: 362 raw categories, 331 after minimal normalization. City CCHICAGO appears 34 times.
possible_reason: Free text permits case variants and spelling errors; some rare values are legitimate.
effect_and_action: Normalize whitespace/case; audit aliases; fit rare-category rules on training only.

problem: Location information is not uniformly Chicago-only
evidence: 339 records have a missing or other City; 64 have missing State.
possible_reason: Spelling errors and records outside the city may coexist.
effect_and_action: Do not fill every State with IL or silently delete non-Chicago entries; audit before geographical claims.

problem: Recorded risk is not a monotonic outcome score
evidence: Low risk Fail rate: 26.26%; High: 22.50%; UNKNOWN has only 3 labelled rows.
possible_reason: Risk category, establishment mix and inspection purpose describe different aspects of the record.
effect_and_action: Use categorical risk and examine interactions; do not assume higher category means higher Fail probability.

evidence: Permitted history begins in 2016; saved source metadata flags a 2018-07-01 procedure change.
possible_reason: Earlier visits may exist outside the allowed window; recording practices can change.
effect_and_action: Interpret no prior judgement as unavailable history; use forward validation and report period sensitivity.
